key.name: magnification
key.description: How large the icon under the pointer becomes, as a multiple of its normal size. 1 turns magnification off.

key.name: reach
key.description: How far the swell spreads to either side, in icons.

key.name: settle-time
key.description: Milliseconds the icons take to return to their size when the pointer leaves the dock. At most 300, so they are back before a hiding dock starts to slide away.
